releases.displayName: Cross-Play Update is Here: Connect with Explorers Everywhere!

items.text: [p align="start"]It’s time to dust off those walkie-talkies because a brand new update has arrived!
[p align="start"]We’re thrilled to announce that cross-play is now available for We Were Here, We Were Here Too, and We Were Here Together!

[p align="start"]That means no matter if you’re playing on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch, you and your partner can now connect and puzzle your way through Castle Rock together, across all platforms.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/e7f94ee585321594e402fc550ed1e39d16285973.png"]

[p align="start"]This has been one of our most requested features, and we’ve poured extra time and care into patching up the games so that your connection works seamlessly between devices. Whether you’re shouting directions from your desk or puzzling from the couch, your partner is now just one connection away.
[p align="start"]Alongside this update, We Were Here Together has now joined the series on Nintendo Switch, opening the doors for a whole new wave of puzzlers to step into the cold. ❄️
[p align="start"]So find your partner, start the call, and see how far your communication can take you.
Because no matter the platform… The only way out is together.

notes.title: Join us for an AMA over on Reddit!

items.text: To celebrate this big milestone, we want to talk to you directly and answer any burning questions you may have for us.
Join us on the r/nintendo subreddit next Thursday October 16th at 3PM CEST / 6AM PDT / 8AM CDT, and you might even win some keys for our games on Switch!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/9d31f5d5a04ff942797c94ed3d668c60cc4c0252.png"]
— Total Mayhem Games

notes.title: Patch notes for We Were Here patch 2.0.21

items.text: Improved UX with pop-up buttons.
Improved Friends and Social panel regarding blocked players.
Improved auto save game select system now properly selecting the last played save.
Fixed invite handling flow when receiving an invite in game when disconnecting back to the title screen.
Fixed gamepad issue on lower end machines losing controls when loading the main menu.
Patch 2.0.20. contains bug fixes. See the details down below.
Theatre puzzle: levers do not rotate when interacting with them using a controller.
Spike puzzle: the instructions on the book on the map table read "start from the east", while it should be "start from the west".
Matchmaking/connection issue at starting screen: players get stuck in an authentication loop after pressing "return to the title screen" in a post leave pop-up.
Matchmaking issue in the lobby: closing the game while in-game and remaking the lobby causes a ready desync.
Text loading issue: loading in from a checkpoint always displays the voice chat tutorial text.
Walkie-talkie issue: player 2's walkie-talkie will react as if player 1 is talking while player 1 holds down the voice button before they pick up the walkie-talkie.

“Loud and clear! Over!” As you may have noticed, we have updated We Were Here on Steam! This patch implements a new voice-chat system called Vivox. This should improve communication between explorers using their walkie-talkies, especially those trapped in Castle Rock!

You also might notice that when booting up We Were Here, the main menu has received a bit of a facelift! Not only is it looking better, it will also keep you up to date with what’s going on with the We Were Here Series… speaking of which…

notes.title: Wear it like you mean it

items.text: We have opened up our brand new merchandise store! There is an even better way to explore Castle Rock when you look the part with your co-op partner! There are different lines of designs, like our simple yet straightforward TMG Essentials designs. Our TMG FOR FRIENDS is there for those who want to relive those memories of being trapped and spending a lot of valuable time together.

But there is limited merchandise as well! Such as Curse of Castle Rock pieces of merch as well as Holiday-related sweaters to keep you and your co-op partner warm! These lines of merchandise are available until January 31st!
Can’t wait to get your own merch? Go to http://www.totalmayhemmerch.com

The explorers sure like to celebrate whenever there is a good occasion to do so! If you explore the basecamp in We Were Here Together, you might find them eating some treats based on a Dutch tradition called ‘Sinterklaas’. Can you find all of them?
There’s also a door on the basecamp that’s yet to be opened… I wonder if there’s something lurking behind that as well…

releases.displayName: We Were Here - Let's Talk Virtual Reality!

items.text: Hi everyone,
Total Mayhem Games is pleased to announce the return of the VR version of We Were Here. From today on you will be able to download the VR version of We Were Here completely for free.

Since we retracted the VR version from Steam our development team has spent many hours optimizing the VR version and has made it more Vive native by adding motion controller support, in favor of a more immersive game experience.
On top of that, a commercial license has been added to the store page. So if your company is interested in using We Were Here for commercial purposes, you can purchase a commercial license.
Haven’t played We Were Here yet? Play it for free!
Let us know what you think!

releases.displayName: Update on We Were Here and We Were Here Too

items.text: We are proud to announce the largest performance update for We Were Here so far! If you haven’t played the game yet or had any issues preventing you from doing so in the past; now is the time!
Development of We Were Here Too is coming along nicely and we’re hoping to release the game in the upcoming months. The store page will be live sometime later this weekend too!

Don’t hesitate to contact us or share your thoughts with us on We Were Here or We Were Here Too! We can be contacted through our social media pages and our website, where you will also find our new Development Blog! The changes made in this patch are numerous, so more detailed information on this can be found here.
We'll also be posting more in-depth details about the design and development of both We Were Here and We Were Here Too.

One important thing to note is that VR support is temporarily disabled. We are currently working on implementing full motion controller support for We Were Here for HTC Vive players to enjoy. We're sorry for this inconvenience.
Have fun and let us know what you think!
Total Mayhem Games

items.text: Hey everyone! Update Four is brought to you from our new office space where we'll be working on We Were Here for the upcoming months! If you still experience an issue that is listed or new issues have presented themself please let us know in the discussions.
Total Mayhem Games
Fixes
Overal stability Voice system
Server browser no longer scrolls to infinity
Ingame menu will no longer show when leaving from an inspectable state
Water SFX are now properly linked to audio options
Wind audio now linked to SFX instead of Music volume
Bloom for VR is disabled by default
Fixed a crash in the main menu for players with a slower connection
Some doors will no longer be interactable after being opened
Interaction distance for the chess game has been increased
Players can no longer turn the handles without locking into them
The text above the "Play Scene" button now updates properly
Microphone should regain focus after disconnecting/connecting the device
The current resolution is now be displayed properly in the options menu
The options menu is now more user friendly
Player movement and camera look are properly locked when browsing the ingame menu
Snow is now less demanding and should not bounce around anymore
Players should now always start loading at the same time
Disabled most rooms by default, they will be enabled on the run
Checkpoints should no longer reset
Matchmaking code is refactored and should smooth out the experience (let us know if any issues arise)
Fixed a bug where players got stuck on a blackscreen with fire sound effects
Added
The options menus have been reworked
Voice calibration, located under audio options
You can now select your microphone in the audio options
"Play Scene" button is now a lever
Back/Escape as navigation options in the ingame menu
Several performance improvements
Added occlusion culling
22 February 2017
As of today some new features have been implemented in the game as we continue to make it more stable. In this patch note we will highlight a couple of important fixes and features listed below.
Patch Notes
Added a warning message when there is no microphone connected
Several Colliders added to avoid players from going out of bounds
You can no longer sneak past the marionette
Theatre audio will now synchronise with audio settings
Roaming audio won't stop playing after skipping intro
Fixed a bug where the film role wasn't interactable after dropping it
You can now click on a chesspiece to attack it, instead of the tile below it
The last sentence of the theatre puzzle has finally been added
You can now hear a snow storm in the final room
Several visual improvements like the player model

A new Room has been added for VR players when in the menu: We are aware that not all bugs might have been fixed (such as the walkie-talkie in some cases), but since we’ve already made some progress we wanted to share this with you. We would also like to thank the community for embracing our game, reporting issues and overall helping us make the game even better!

items.text: We are rolling out a new update that fixes several issues and adds a much-requested feature.We will continue to improve the stability of the game with future updates.
Fixes
Improved interaction with handles in the theater
Theater now resets properly after each correct play
Theater plays can no longer be cheated
Escape hatch in theater should no longer clip through wall
Several Colliders added to avoid players from going out of bounds
Interaction with books has been improved
Added
You can now start from checkpoints (they need to be unlocked)
The puppet in the theater just got a whole lot scarier
People you have played with should be visible in Recently Played (Steam)
I've seen several posts about the theater, the solutions given in the guide are no longer correct. Some solutions given in the guide were marked as correct due to a bug.
We are aware several players are having trouble launching the game, we are doing our best to solve this problem.
We would like to thank everyone for playing We Were Here!

We are aware of some of the issues some players might be having and are monitoring the discussions to see what other issues arise. Below you will find a list of issues that have been fixed for this first patch.
Fixes
Resolved a crash issue related to a certain checkpoint
Improved interaction distance for certain objects
Inspecting books in VR should no longer spawn the player on random locations
Added colliders in several places to avoid players going out of bounds
Chess pieces are now a little easier to see
Fixed several textures
Total room limit has been increased
Added
You can now inspect the portrait in the Study room
We are also looking into some of the feature requests posted in the reviews/discussions to see if we can make these happen.Save game perhaps :)
Again a big thank you from the We Were Here team, if you have more feedback or feature requests you can post them in the Steam discussions.
